lines: That was blunt enough to disappoint an arrow.
I have seen crooked shots with more sense than that.
Careful. Even feather looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken arrows with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
You missed the point from two steps away.
I have seen bent arrows fly straighter than that thought.
Your manners need fletching and a better spine.
That confidence has poor aim and worse balance.
You are all tension and no release.
I would not trust that idea downrange.
A dull arrowhead has more edge than you just showed.
You make the target look quick witted.
Your sense drifts worse than feathers in a storm.
That remark landed sideways and snapped.
Even a bad shot teaches more than you did.
I could straighten a branch before straightening your logic.
You are the warning I give apprentices before practice.
That thought should stay in the quiver.
A loose string has better restraint.
Keep testing patience and you will learn how warnings travel.
